summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in parallel_execution/worker_initialization domain focused on ThreadPoolExecutor initializer configuration. It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (Script Loading Control and GRPO Loss Formulation are in unrelated domains: ui_optimization and loss_computation). Peer candidates (Map Function, ProcessPoolExecutor Lifecycle, Submit Callable) are related but operate at different stages and task families; this skill is specifically about ThreadPoolExecutor initializer setup at pool_configuration stage, not task dispatch, batch processing, or process-level lifecycle. The skill has valid support evidence and no conflicts.
